newsitem.title: CUBA: Cuban police clamp down on fake cigar vendors.
newsitem.headline: Cuban police clamp down on fake cigar vendors.

text.p: Cuban police have detained 10 people on suspicion they conned tourists by selling supposedly top notch cigars that were in fact poor quality ones boxed and labelled with famous brand names, officials said on Saturday.

The state news agency AIN said police found a clandestine workshop in the city of Cardenas, near the tourist resort of Varadero, that made the boxes. Police also seized labels and stamps of some of the best Cuban cigar brands, it said.

AIN said boxes were then filled with poor quality cigars and sold to unsuspecting tourists in Varadero. Ten people had been detained on suspicion of taking part in the scam, AIN said. It did not say when the police operation took place.
Tourists in Havana and Varadero are often accosted by people in the street claiming to sell brands such as Cohiba at prices well below those of the state cigar shops.
